examples.pie: nu déh₂nu téwe wódr̥ stoh₂éye h₁mé mē lémbʰs. nu wódr̥ bʰérǵʰu mē h₁syéh₁t h₁íd gʷm̥tóm h₁syéh₁t. nu péroh₂ nu-kʷe h₂én stéh₂oh₂. méne h₁éḱwōs prih₁ént déh₃rom toy h₁áyoh₂.
examples.en: Now, river, make your water stand! Do not seize me! May the water not be high; may it be passable! Now I shall cross, and I shall stand on the other side. May my horses cross; I shall give you a gift.

examples.pie: gʰrómom ḱlush₁yési? h₁ím ḱlush₁yóh₂. pérkʷunos kl̥Hn̥bʰós gʷm̥sḱéti. kúdʰe ḱélōmesdʰh₂? dréwi Hn̥dʰí mē sth₂éh₁yes. pérkʷunos bʰérǵʰuh₂ dóruh₂ gʷʰénti. poh₂imnés dṓm drémomes.
examples.en: Do you hear the thunder? I hear it. The storm god is coming from the hills. Where shall we hide? Do not stand under a tree. The storm god strikes the high trees. Let us run to the shepherd's house.

examples.pie: nu snusós sékʷt. dáyh₂wer gʷówes ḱm̥h₂ént. nu tr̥syóh₂. nu só h₂éǵt. snúse wódr̥ píph₃e. sóh₂wl̥ bʰérǵʰu h₁ésti. tóns gʰórdʰom déwkomes. sédomes h₁édomes-kʷe puHróm. puHrós bʰuh₂yéh₁t. h₂éḱesh₂ pl̥h₁yéh₁t.
examples.en: Then the daughter-in-law said: "Husband's brother, the cattle became tired. Now I am thirsty." Then he said: "Drink water, daughter-in-law. The sun is high. Let us lead them to the hedge. Let us sit and eat the grain." "May the grain grow." "May the ears of grain fill."

examples.pie: h₂éwsōs h₂wést. bʰéwdʰesi? nu bʰéwdʰoh₂. h₁eǵʰ gʷm̥dʰí sóh₂wl̥-kʷe widé.
examples.en: Dawn has become bright. Are you awake? Yes, I am awake. Come out, and see the sun!

examples.pie: súHnew bʰéwdʰe h₁regʷesyéti. stéh₂dʰh₁om spéḱye wókʷm̥ ḱléwse nu mē légʰs.
examples.en: Be awake, son, be awake, it is getting dark. Look at the herd, listen to the voice! Do not lie down.

examples.pie: wĺ̥kʷe kú yéh₂si? h₂ówins h₁éymi. mē yéh₂s. poh₂imḗn bʰéwdʰeti h₂ówins-kʷe péh₂smi.
examples.en: "Wolf, where are you going?" "I am going to the sheep." "Do not go! The shepherd is awake, and I am guarding the sheep."

root.gloss: to produce; to beget; to give birth

examples.pie: ḱwṓ nos kʷetwṓr téḱneh₂ ǵonh₁éyet. h₁óynom moy dh₃dʰí h₂egʷnóm-kʷe toy déh₃oh₂. dwóh₁ moy h₂egʷnóh₁ dh₃dʰí. gʰóstey túH ǵn̥h₃rós. tóh₁ toy dédeh₃oh₂.
examples.en: Our dog gave birth to four pups. Give me one, and I will give you a lamb. Give me two lambs! You are clever, stranger. I will give you the two.

examples.pie: nu wos déywōs ḱóm ugʷsénm̥ dedh₃més. mórom stégesbʰos h₂pó sl̥h₂gʷté. h₂yuHn̥ḱṓs mr̥yóntor sénōs mr̥yóntor. ń̥mr̥tōs nos mē gʰrémete. móros-ge nos póyḱons gʷh₂yéh₁t.
examples.en: Gods, now we give you this ox. Take the plague away from the houses! The young are dying, the old ones are dying. Immortals, do not rage at us! May the plague indeed go to our enemies.

examples.pie: h₁yós h₂éwim tn̥tlṓd sléh₂gʷeti só bʰṓr. h₁yód h₃éronm̥ sléh₂gʷeti nu h₃rēǵéy h₁éḱwom déh₃tu. h₁yós h₂éwim tn̥tlṓd h₂pó léh₁eti nu tn̥tlóm tḗtḱtu. h₃érō diwéy lewbʰós.
examples.en: Whoever snatches a bird from the net, that man is a thief. If he snatches an eagle, let him give the king a stallion. Whoever lets the bird away from the net, let him make a net. The eagle is dear to the sky.

examples.pie: h₁ludʰét dʰǵʰúHm̥ bʰéronts ḱwṓ wédos nu ḱwónm̥ wédni spéḱyet. dʰǵʰúHm̥ moy toy dh₃dʰí nu HréwdHt nu h₃sléydʰt só wódr̥ h₁h₃sés wédos-kʷe tóm h₂pó wéǵʰet. h₁yós polh₁ú h₂isḱéti swóm tósmey néḱt.
examples.en: A dog carrying a fish came to the water. Then he looked at a dog in the water. "Give me your fish!" Then he cried out. Then it slipped from the mouth into the water, and the water transported it off. Whoever seeks much, his own vanishes.

examples.pie: h₁óyneh₂ h₂ówis médʰyoy h₂éǵroy stéygʰet.
examples.en: One sheep was walking in the middle field.

examples.pie: pĺ̥th₂ew tń̥tle ǵʰwḗrm̥ lm̥bʰdʰí h₁ím kapyé. twéd kʷid mē bʰugyéh₁t tn̥tlós-kʷe pl̥nh₁ih₁tó.
examples.en: Broad net, seize the beast, hold it! May nothing flee from you, and may the net become full.

examples.pie: kʷíd pl̥th₂ú h₁ésti? léymō pl̥th₂ús h₁ésti.
examples.en: What is broad? The lake is broad.

examples.pie: dyéw-ge ph₂ter dweh₂róm póntoh₁m̥ h₁imés. nu-kʷe nos stóygʰom h₃roǵéye. mē ḱm̥h₂ih₁mé lewbʰéh₂ nos h₂éwsōs wédʰoyh₁t.
examples.en: Father Sky, we indeed go a long path. And now make our way straight. May we not grow tired. May dear Dawn lead us.

examples.pie: kʷíh₁ mléwHmi? snéygʷʰeti. snéygʷʰeti. swesréy toy wéwke. snígʷʰs póntoh₁i ḱéyor. ǵʰéyōm gʷegʷóme. stóygʰoy mē h₃sléydʰs.
examples.en: How do I say it? It is snowing. It is snowing. Say it to your sister! Snow is lying on the path. Winter has come. Do not slip on the way!

examples.pie: ḱémh₂m̥. ḱósmi dinóy wr̥ǵyés? wr̥ǵyóm póntoh₁i-kʷe stéygʰom. kéh₂re l̥gʰdʰí ssdʰí-kʷe. kéh₂ilos pós h₁ésesi. nu légʰyoh₂.
examples.en: I have grown tired. Were you working today? I was working, and I walked along the path. Lie down, dear one, and sleep! Afterwards you will be well. Now I am lying down.

examples.pie: ménos pró h₁éyti ǵʰóstos-kʷe sékʷetor. téwe ǵʰóstos pró mē dr̥myéh₁t.
examples.en: The mind goes forward, and the hand follows. May your hand not run ahead.

examples.pie: lewbʰóm kólHonm̥ h₁imés ḱwṓ pró h₁éyti. sékʷomesdʰh₂-kʷe gʷéh₂omes.

examples.en: If a dead man leaves a small orphan, let the widow hold the payment. When he has grown up, let him decide. If the widow does not take the price, let no one threaten her. Grief is not a trade.

examples.pie: kʷíd h₂éwh₂e ǵérh₂ontes ph₂wéni h₁épi nókʷtm̥ pér sédyonti? mórǵm̥ h₂réh₁dʰonti. mórtos wérh₁yeti h₂élyōs-kʷe ḱléwsonti. kʷóm h₂réh₁dʰōnti? h₁yód h₂wéseti h₂réh₁dʰōnti. téḱnom l̥gʰdʰí ssdʰí-kʷe. bʰéwdʰōh₂ ḱléwsōh₂-kʷe.

examples.pie: preḱnós méǵʰye h₁ésti. préḱsdʰi. h₂enterowékʷos wéwkōh₂. kʷóti wékʷesh₂ wóydth₂e? polh₁úh₂ wékʷesh₂ wóydh₂e.
examples.en: I have a question. Ask! I will speak the answer. How many words do you know? I know many words.

examples.pie: ǵérh₂ont móri dweh₂róm? h₁íd dweh₂róm. kʷóti nókʷtn̥s póntoh₁i sésomes? septḿ̥ nókʷtn̥s. uksénes gʷr̥déwes. nu h₁éḱwons yéwgomes.
examples.en: Old man, is the sea far? It is far. How many nights shall we sleep on the way? Seven nights. Oxen are slow. Then we will yoke the horses.

examples.pie: kʷóti h₂stéres dyéwi h₁sénti? ne kʷis wóyde. méh₂tēr moy mléwHti h₂stéres diwés gʷówes. kʷís h₁íns péh₂sti? lówksneh₂ h₁íns péh₂sti.
examples.en: How many stars are in the sky? No one knows. My mother says: the stars are the cattle of Sky. And who shepherds them? The Moon shepherds them.
